scripts.build: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run -r --filter './sites/*' --filter './services/*' --if-present build
scripts.test: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts test && nub run --filter @codeops/agents-ui test && nub run -r --filter './services/*' --if-present --workspace-concurrency 4 test
scripts.acceptance:agents-ui: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run --filter @codeops/agents-ui build && nub run --filter @codeops/acceptance-runner test:browser
scripts.prove:lifecycle-relay: nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-contracts build && nub run --filter @codeops/codeops-control-gateway build && node infra/scripts/prove-lifecycle-jetstream-relay.mjs
scripts.verify: nub run build && nub run typecheck && nub run test && nub run check:chart
